about: ASSISTANT judgments (not independent) for every ANSWERED reply to an answerable question in the baseline, against expected_answer in datasets/datasets.json. Keyed <run dir name>/<question_id>. Phase 12 c3 grades are copied from experiments/phase12/phase12c/answer_judgments.json unchanged.

phase12_c3_reused/t05.why: copied from Phase 12: 65.9 vs expected 64.0; verifier false acceptance (c3 rows carry no check marks)

live_ext/q03.why: Inner Monologue predicts time-aligned text tokens before audio tokens and improves factuality and linguistic quality (MOSHI:1:c007), almost tripling spoken QA accuracy (MOSHI:5.5:c091); the expected answer's ASR/TTS remark is not asked by the question

live_ext/q06.why: the reply lists real tokenization limitations from HNET:A:c088 (vocabulary bias, adversarial fragility, character-level tasks) but not the expected motivation (tokenization as a barrier to end-to-end models; no tokenizer-free model had matched tokenized ones); expected gold not in context
